traits.name: False Appearance
traits.text:
While the gargoyle remains motionless, it is
indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The gargoyle makes four attacks: one with its bite, two with its claws, and one gore.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
